body.statement: For every finite input \(I\), the unique run from \(\operatorname{init}_H(I)\) is locally sound and cannot be stuck at a nonresidual control state.  Every context, truncated-factorization, computed-fixing, hybrid, factor, and Join step preserves the represented normalized observation--target relation on its ledger-positive domain and records its exact local identity.  Each nonterminal nonresidual step strictly decreases the finite-multiset extension \(\mu_H\) of the displayed task rank.  Hence the run reaches after finitely many steps either one formula result, one verifier-accepted global-twin result, or one \(\operatorname{ResidualPending}\) result.  A pending residual is the only possible noncertificate endpoint.
body.proof_tex:
Determinacy and nonresidual progress are \(\textnormal{prop:input-determinacy}\) and \(\textnormal{lem:nonresidual-progress}\).  Local soundness follows case by case.  Context evaluation and its base division are sound by \(\textnormal{lem:context-construction-soundness}\); chain-rule extraction is sound by \(\textnormal{lem:truncated-factorization-identity}\); every computed fixing quotient satisfies its cross-multiplied identity by \(\textnormal{lem:computed-fixing-soundness}\); the Algorithm-2 splice is sound by \(\textnormal{lem:hybrid-kernel-soundness}\); and final multiplication and marginalization are sound by \(\textnormal{lem:district-assembly-soundness}\).  The ledger lemma makes every division reversible on \(O_H(\Theta_H)\).  A verified residual projection satisfies
\[
 D\,t_{a,H}^{N}-P(o_H^{N})=0
\]
with \(D>0\), so it emits the asserted formula.  A verified contrast satisfies the two observation identities, target inequality, simplex inequalities, exact-support signs, and cell-positivity signs before gate reinsertion; normalization equivalence transports them to the original model.  Candidate exhaustion emits only \(\operatorname{ResidualPending}\), not a causal conclusion.

It remains to prove termination.  The lexicographic order on
\(\mathbb N^4\) is well founded: in an infinite descent the first coordinate eventually stabilizes, then the second, third, and fourth do likewise, a contradiction.  Associate to a task rank \((n,c,f,k)\) the ordinal
\[
 \rho(n,c,f,k)=\omega^3n+\omega^2c+\omega f+k<\omega^4.
\]
For a finite task multiset \(M\), take the natural sum
\(\Omega(M)=\mathop{\#\!\sum}_{\tau\in M}\omega^{\rho(r_I(\tau))}\).
If one task is removed or replaced by finitely many tasks of strictly smaller rank, the leading term contributed by that task disappears and all new terms have smaller exponent; hence \(\Omega\) strictly decreases.  This is exactly the Dershowitz--Manna multiset extension and proves it well founded.

Now inspect the cases.  Start and district splitting replace a task by finitely many proper-mask children, or by equal-mask administrative children with lower control level.  Advancing a phase lowers its control level.  A fixing step lowers the remaining-fix count, and its last step invokes a lower-control continuation.  A failed A2 candidate lowers the remaining-candidate count; a successful one enters lower-control hybrid fixing.  Factor and Join completion remove tasks.  Thus every nonterminal nonresidual successor strictly decreases \(\mu_H\).  A finite descent must end.  Nonresidual progress excludes every endpoint except Formula, a verified twin, or ResidualPending, and determinacy permits at most one result.
body.justification: The result now covers reachable runs of one total input-determined case function, with exact local identities and a work-multiset measure that handles spawned district tasks.
body.gap: The obsolete scalar token count proved only finiteness of supplied transitions; it did not prove agenda construction, nonresidual progress, or termination across recursive splits.
body.consumer: An implementation can replay each state, fixing sequence, candidate scan, and denominator proof from the finite input and log alone.
